title: STRENGTH & SONG
A MIDDAY PRAYER
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon

scenes.a: That overwhelming task sitting on your desk right now is draining your stamina this afternoon.
Hear the timeless promise of Scripture: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
Lord, in this sunlit midday hour when our energy fails, we lean completely upon Your unfailing power.
You are not only our shield in dark moments; You are the gladness that restores our spirit right now.
When fatigue clouds our thoughts, be our constant endurance and our quiet peace.
You carry every burden we cannot bear alone today. Thank You for being our victory in every trial.
